Sandbox_HydeCoUnlimitedCars_AdvancedBurn: Only used when Preset = Custom. 0 = never burnt, 100 = always burnt.
Sandbox_HydeCoUnlimitedCars_AdvancedInje: Custom: add trailers to common zones

Only used when Preset = Custom. Adds trailer vehicle types into common zone lists (parking lots/residential/commercial), so they can actually spawn there. Use together with trailer spawn bias to see more trailers overall.
Custom: add unique vehicles to common zones
Only used when Preset = Custom. Injects a small pool of branded/service vans (Spiffo/Radio/Butchers/Mail etc) into common zones so they can appear more widely.
Sandbox_HydeCoUnlimitedCars_AdvancedKeyC: Only used when Preset = Custom. Chance the vehicle spawns with a key available.
Sandbox_HydeCoUnlimitedCars_AdvancedPart: Only used when Preset = Custom. Adds/sets how often parts spawn damaged.
Sandbox_HydeCoUnlimitedCars_AdvancedSpaw: Only used when Preset = Custom. Multiplies each zone's spawnRate (clamped to 100). 1.0 = vanilla rates.
Sandbox_HydeCoUnlimitedCars_AdvancedSpec: Only used when Preset = Custom. Sets each zone's chanceToSpawnSpecial (special vehicles like police/fire/ambulance). Higher values = more emergency vehicles everywhere.
Sandbox_HydeCoUnlimitedCars_AdvancedTrai: Only used when Preset = Custom. Boosts how often trailer-type vehicles (names containing 'Trailer') are chosen inside a zone. 1.0 = no change, 2.0 = about twice as common, 0.0 = disable trailers (only in zones that already include them).
Sandbox_HydeCoUnlimitedCars_AdvancedUniq: Only used when Preset = Custom. Boosts branded/service vehicles (Spiffo/Radio/Butchers and many underscore variants like StepVan_* and Van_*).
Only used when Preset = Custom. How much of each zone's vehicle-type weighting is reserved for injected unique vehicles (1-50).
Sandbox_HydeCoUnlimitedCars_AdvancedVanB: Only used when Preset = Custom. Boosts how often van-type vehicles are chosen inside each zone. 1.0 = no change, 2.0 = about twice as common.
Sandbox_HydeCoUnlimitedCars_AdvancedVehi: Only used when Preset = Custom. Higher values mean better parts when damaged (roughly).
Sandbox_HydeCoUnlimitedCars_DebugLogging: Prints server-side info (preset, zones touched, vanilla CarSpawnRate) to help diagnose MP/dedicated issues.
Sandbox_HydeCoUnlimitedCars_EqualizeVehi: When enabled (and Preset is not Vanilla), each vehicle type inside a zone has equal chance. This affects variety, not total count.
Sandbox_HydeCoUnlimitedCars_Preset_optio: 11 = Keyless Horde (max cars, almost no keys)
12 = Jalopy World (normal counts, very damaged, not burnt)
13 = Burnt Horde (max cars, mostly burnt + wrecked)
14 = Showroom No Keys (pristine cars, no keys)
15 = Trailer Town (normal-ish counts, trailers show up a lot)
17 = Van World (VANPOCALYPSE: max spawns, vans only)
8 = Max Cars + Pristine (max spawns, perfect-ish parts)
9 = Max Cars + Wrecks (max spawns, heavily damaged mix)
Sandbox_HydeCoUnlimitedCars_Preset_toolt: Controls what the mod does. Default is Vanilla (no changes).
